pairs.target: yòu guò liǎngtiān dào cè yuàn shí , shéng lù shōu qǐlái le , ǎi jiàshàng bǎi zhe liǎngmiàn xiǎo mù dùn , dùn bèi de wòbǎ kuān , biānshàng bāo zhe mó bái de bù .
pairs.english: When he reached the side yard two days later, the rope course had been put away; two small wooden shields stood on a low rack, their rear grips broad, their edges wrapped in cloth worn white.
pairs.hanzi: 又过两天到侧院时，绳路收起来了，矮架上摆着两面小木盾，盾背的握把宽，边上包着磨白的布。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān qù kàn dùn bèi , sòng yuǎn shuō lǐmiàn méiyǒu tiě , bié fān le , jīnrì ná tāmen rèn wèizhì , bú jiè xìng , yě bú duì zhe rén yònglì qiāo .
pairs.english: Tavi first went to inspect the backs; Song Yuan said there was no iron inside, so stop turning them over: today they would use them to learn positions, without borrowing properties or striking people hard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先去看盾背，宋远说里面没有铁，别翻了，今日拿它们认位置，不借性，也不对着人用力敲。

pairs.target: tā jiào tǎ wéi qīng wò yìhuí , wèn yòuzhǎng mó bu mó , tǎ wéi shuō bù mó , wò jiǔ le háishì fājǐn , sòng yuǎn biàn bǎ yìhuí de shíchén yòu suōduǎn xiē .
pairs.english: He told Tavi to try one gentle grip and asked whether it chafed his right palm; Tavi said it did not, but holding on long still felt tight, so Song Yuan shortened each turn's duration further.
pairs.hanzi: 他叫塔维轻握一回，问右掌磨不磨，塔维说不磨，握久了还是发紧，宋远便把一回的时辰又缩短些。

pairs.target: lín kē yǐ bǎ dùn tào zài zuǒbì shàng , yòushǒu ná yìgēn duǎn mùbàng , jiàn tā dīng zhe dùn , gùyì cóng pángbiān shēnchū bàng duān , tíng zài tā yīdài qián .
pairs.english: Lin Ke already had the shield on her left arm and held a short wooden stick in her right hand; seeing him stare at the shield, she deliberately extended its tip from the side and halted before his sash.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂已把盾套在左臂上，右手拿一根短木棒，见他盯着盾，故意从旁边伸出棒端，停在他衣带前。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎnghòu yì duǒ , tā shuō zìjǐ méi pèng , sòng yuǎn shuō tā ruò pèng le , jīnrì xiān qù sǎo yuàn , liǎnggè réncái gè tuìhuí yíkuài píng shí shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi dodged backward; she said she had not touched him, and Song Yuan said if she had, she could start today by sweeping the yard; only then did each of them retreat onto a flat stone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往后一躲，她说自己没碰，宋远说她若碰了，今日先去扫院，两个人才各退回一块平石上。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn ràng lín kē bú dòng , jiào tǎ wéi bǎ zuǒ dùn fàngzài xiōngqián , yòushǒu kōng zhe , cóng dùn hòu kàn tā , tā xiān bǎ bànzhāng liǎn dōu cáng le jìnqù .
pairs.english: Song Yuan told Lin Ke to stay still and Tavi to put his left shield before his chest, keeping his right hand empty, and look at her from behind it; Tavi first hid fully half his face.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远让林珂不动，叫塔维把左盾放在胸前，右手空着，从盾后看她，他先把半张脸都藏了进去。

pairs.target: dùn yán zhēzhù tā de shǒu , jiǎoxià yě zhǐ kànjiàn yìxiǎokuài , tā bǎtóu piān chūqù , lín kē quèshuō , tā xiān kànjiàn tā de étóu le .
pairs.english: The shield's edge concealed her hand, and below he could see only a little patch of ground; he tilted his head out, but Lin Ke said she had seen his forehead first.
pairs.hanzi: 盾沿遮住她的手，脚下也只看见一小块，他把头偏出去，林珂却说，她先看见他的额头了。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎnzǒu guòlái , méiyǒu tì tā bǎ dùn tái dào zhèngquè dìfāng , zhǐ bǎ mùbàng héng zài liǎng rén zhījiān , jiào tā kàn dùn dī yìdiǎn shí néng kànjiàn shénme .
pairs.english: Song Yuan came over without lifting the shield into the right place for him; he merely laid the stick across the space between them and asked what he could see when the shield was a little lower.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远走过来，没有替他把盾抬到正确地方，只把木棒横在两人之间，叫他看盾低一点时能看见什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mànmàn fàng dī , lín kē de liǎngzhī xié xiānlù chūlái , suíhòu shì wò bàng de shǒu , zìjǐ de xiōngkǒu què yě lù le yì jié , tā yòu xiǎng táihuíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi lowered it slowly; Lin Ke's two shoes appeared first, then the hand holding the stick, but a strip of his own chest was exposed too, and he wanted to lift it back again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维慢慢放低，林珂的两只鞋先露出来，随后是握棒的手，自己的胸口却也露了一截，他又想抬回去。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shuō kànjiàn hé dǎngzhù dōu yào dìfāng , méi rén néng bǎ yímiàn xiǎo dùn jǔ chéng zhěngdǔ qiáng , jiào tā xiān jìzhù zìjǐ cǐkè shèdiào le nǎyíkuài .
pairs.english: Song Yuan said seeing and blocking both needed room: nobody could raise one small shield into an entire wall; he told him first to remember which area he was giving up at this moment.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远说看见和挡住都要地方，没人能把一面小盾举成整堵墙，叫他先记住自己此刻舍掉了哪一块。

pairs.target: tā shì zhe cèshēn , yòujiān wǎnghòu shōu , jiǎo què gēnzhe bàn zài yìqǐ , lín kē xiào le yíxià , gǎnjǐn bǎ xiào shōuzhù , zìjǐ zhào zuò shí yě pèng le dùn yán .
pairs.english: He tried turning sideways, drawing his right shoulder back, but his feet tangled together; Lin Ke laughed briefly and quickly suppressed the laugh, then caught the shield's edge herself when she copied him.
pairs.hanzi: 他试着侧身，右肩往后收，脚却跟着绊在一起，林珂笑了一下，赶紧把笑收住，自己照做时也碰了盾沿。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shuō búyòng rěn , děnghuìer huàn tā gěi tā kàn , liǎnggè rén xiào wán , tǎ wéi cái fāxiàn yòushǒu yòu zuàn jǐn le , biàn sōngkāi shuǎi le shuǎi .
pairs.english: Song Yuan said there was no need to suppress it: in a moment it would be her turn to show him; after both had laughed, Tavi only then noticed his right hand had clenched again, so he opened it and shook it out.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远说不用忍，等会儿换她给他看，两个人笑完，塔维才发现右手又攥紧了，便松开甩了甩。

pairs.target: xiē guò yìhuí , sòng yuǎn nálái zìjǐ de jiù dùn hé mùzhàng , jiāng liǎngpiàn kě xiè de tiě lù gěi tāmen kàn , jiāng tāmen gē shàng ǎi jià , chá guò zhěngpiàn hé kèxiàn , zài guà shàng xiǎo yā mù shì gèzì de tuìràng .
pairs.english: After a rest, Song Yuan brought his own old shield and wooden staff, exposing the two removable iron pieces for them to view; he set the implements on the low rack, checked the whole pieces and marks, then hung small loading blocks to test their individual yielding.
pairs.hanzi: 歇过一回，宋远拿来自己的旧盾和木杖，将两片可卸的铁露给他们看，将它们搁上矮架，查过整片和刻线，再挂上小压木试各自的退让。

pairs.target: dùn shàng de tiě zài wòbǎ hòu de huá jià lǐ , zhàng shàng de cáng zài hùshǒu páng , liǎngchù dōu néng ràng tā de shǒuzhǎng pèng zhe , què dōu búshì zhěngmiàn mùtou .
pairs.english: The iron on the shield lay within a sliding frame behind its grip, the staff's concealed beside the guard; both contact points could be reached by his palms, yet neither was the wood as a whole.
pairs.hanzi: 盾上的铁在握把后的滑架里，杖上的藏在护手旁，两处都能让他的手掌碰着，却都不是整面木头。

pairs.target: lín kē yòng bāo bù de bàng duān mànmàn tuī dùn , sòng yuǎn xiān bú jiè xìng , jiào tǎ wéi kàn dùn miàn wǎnghòuzǒu dào nǎlǐ , děng yālì chèdiào , yòu chá le yícì .
pairs.english: Lin Ke slowly pushed the shield with the cloth-wrapped tip; Song Yuan first refrained from borrowing properties and told Tavi to watch how far the shield face moved backward, then checked once again after the pressure was removed.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂用包布的棒端慢慢推盾，宋远先不借性，叫塔维看盾面往后走到哪里，等压力撤掉，又查了一次。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí tā réng bǎ liǎngjiàn qìxiè zhī zài jiàshàng , jiē zhù tóngyàng qīng de tuīlì , liǎngshǒu jiēchù zhe jiè xìng , dùn hòu de tiě duō tuìràng yìdiǎn , zhàng páng nà piàn shǎo yìdiǎn , dùn miàn suí huá jià xiàng hòu ràng .
pairs.english: On the second turn he still supported both implements on the rack, taking the same gentle push; borrowing properties with both hands in contact, he made the shield's iron yield a little more and the staff's piece a little less, and the shield face gave backward with the sliding frame.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回他仍把两件器械支在架上，接住同样轻的推力，两手接触着借性，盾后的铁多退让一点，杖旁那片少一点，盾面随滑架向后让。

pairs.target: tā méi jiào lín kē jiālì , liǎngbiān shōuhuí , chá guò yuánlái de fǎnyìng , cái jiào tā bǎ bàng yíkāi , xièxià xiǎo yā mù , jiāng qìxiè fàng huí jiàshàng .
pairs.english: He did not ask Lin Ke to press harder; he canceled both sides and checked their original responses before telling her to move the stick away, removing the loading blocks and putting the implements back on the rack.
pairs.hanzi: 他没叫林珂加力，两边收回、查过原来的反应，才叫她把棒移开，卸下小压木，将器械放回架上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn ruò bàng láidekuài , shìbushì biàn néng bǎ lì quán jiēxià , sòng yuǎn bǎ dùn biān yíchù jiù lièhén fān gěi tā , shuō zhè dōngxī méiyǒu tìrén xǔ guò nàzhǒng yuàn .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether, if the stick came fast, it could take all the force; Song Yuan turned one old crack in the shield's edge toward him and said this object had never granted people that sort of wish.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问若棒来得快，是不是便能把力全接下，宋远把盾边一处旧裂痕翻给他，说这东西没有替人许过那种愿。

pairs.target: tuìràng tài duō , dùn zhàoyàng zhuàng shàng zìjǐ de lèigǔ , huá jià zǒu dàodǐ , hòutou yě búhuì píngkōng duōchū yì jié lù , gèng biéshuō rén huì huàn dìfāng dǎ .
pairs.english: With too much yielding, the shield would still hit one's own ribs; once the sliding frame reached its limit, no extra stretch of travel would magically appear behind it, let alone account for people striking elsewhere.
pairs.hanzi: 退让太多，盾照样撞上自己的肋骨，滑架走到底，后头也不会凭空多出一截路，更别说人会换地方打。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán jiào lín kē zhǐ bǎ kōng bàng dìguòlái , bù tuī , zìjǐ jǔqǐ méiyǒu jiè xìng de dùn , bàng duān cóng dùn páng ràoguòqù , qīngqīng tíng zài tā de yāodài biān .
pairs.english: After speaking, he asked Lin Ke simply to extend the plain stick without pushing; he raised the shield without borrowing properties, and its tip circled around the shield's side and stopped gently beside his belt.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完叫林珂只把空棒递过来，不推，自己举起没有借性的盾，棒端从盾旁绕过去，轻轻停在他的腰带边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe nà jié mùtou , hūrán yǒudiǎn nǎo , xiàng fāngcái hǎobùróngyì kàn míngbái de shì , yòu bèi sòng yuǎn qīnshǒu chāidiào yíbàn .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at that length of wood, suddenly a little irritated, as though the thing he had only just struggled to understand had been half dismantled again by Song Yuan's own hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着那截木头，忽然有点恼，像方才好不容易看明白的事，又被宋远亲手拆掉一半。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méi ānwèi tā , bǎ bàng jiāodào tā zuǒshǒu , wèn ruò shì tā , kěnbukěn zhǐ tiāo biérén dǎng de zuìhǎo de dìfāng xiàshǒu , tā xiǎng le bàntiān , shuō bùkěn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not comfort him, but handed the stick to his left hand and asked whether he himself would willingly choose only the place someone else defended best to strike; he thought for ages and said no.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没安慰他，把棒交到他左手，问若是他，肯不肯只挑别人挡得最好的地方下手，他想了半天，说不肯。

pairs.target: lín kē shuō tā yě bùkěn , sòng yuǎn shuō nà biàn bié bǎ liànxí shí de kèqì dàngzhēn , yòu jiào liǎng rén bǎ kōng dùn ná huílái , zhè yìhuí zhǐ rèn kàndejiàn de fànwéi .
pairs.english: Lin Ke said she would not either; Song Yuan said then not to take practice courtesy as real, and asked both of them to retrieve the plain shields: this turn, just learn the visible range.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂说她也不肯，宋远说那便别把练习时的客气当真，又叫两人把空盾拿回来，这一回只认看得见的范围。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi zài jí zhe jiāng liǎn cáng zhù , réng lòu zhe jiān , què néng kànjiàn lín kē shénme shíhòu bǎ jiǎojiān zhuǎnxiàng wàibiān , sānhuí lǐ cāi cuò liǎnghuí , cāi duì nà huí yě méi láidejí dòng .
pairs.english: Tavi no longer rushed to hide his face; his shoulder remained exposed, but he could see when Lin Ke turned her toes outward; he guessed wrong twice in three turns, and even the correct guess left no time to move.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没再急着将脸藏住，仍漏着肩，却能看见林珂什么时候把脚尖转向外边，三回里猜错两回，猜对那回也没来得及动。

pairs.target: shōu dùn shí tā yòuzhǎng méiyǒu pò , sòng yuǎn réng jiào tā jīnrì bié zài zìjǐ zhǎo dōngxī wò zhe liàn , lín kē bǎ mùbàng yìgēn gēn páiqí , wèn tā hòu rì hái lái bu lái .
pairs.english: His right palm was unbroken when they put the shields away; Song Yuan still told him not to find objects for more grip practice on his own today; Lin Ke lined up the sticks one by one and asked if he would come again the day after tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 收盾时他右掌没有破，宋远仍叫他今日别再自己找东西握着练，林珂把木棒一根根排齐，问他后日还来不来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō gé sāntiān , tā cái xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ suàncuò , zhòu zhe bízi bǎ zuì duǎn de yìgēn sāi dào tā shǒubiān , shuō nà jīntiān yě shǎosuàn yìgēn .
pairs.english: Tavi said the interval was three days; only then did she remember her miscount, wrinkling her nose and shoving the shortest stick beside his hand, saying then count one fewer today too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说隔三天，她才想起自己算错，皱着鼻子把最短的一根塞到他手边，说那今天也少算一根。

pairs.target: tā tì tā shǔwán , méiyǒu bǎ dùn dàizǒu , huíláng xià shí zuǒ jiān suān , ěrbiān què hái liú zhe mùbàng ràoguò dùn yán nà yíxià qīngqīng de cā shēng .
pairs.english: He finished counting for her and did not take the shield away; back under the corridor his left shoulder ached, but in his ears lingered that one soft scrape of the stick circling the shield's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 他替她数完，没有把盾带走，回廊下时左肩酸，耳边却还留着木棒绕过盾沿那一下轻轻的擦声。
